title: Amazon EventBridge to Amazon SQS
description: Create an EventBridge rule that invokes an SQS queue.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains sample AWS CDK code to create an EventBridge rule, as well as an SQS queue. The EventBridge rule publishes matched events to the SQS queue. In this example, the rule filters for specific attributes in the event before sending the event to the queue.

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to send a test event to EventBridge:
1. Send an event to EventBridge: aws events put-events --entries file://event.json.
2. Retrieve the message from the SQS queue, using the queue URL from the AWS SAM deployment outputs: aws sqs receive-message --queue-url ENTER_YOUR_QUEUE_URL.
